anomalies.observed: On sheet 1, block 'Water Level Sensor/Switches', the LiDAR part PR6 (LIDAR) is wired through header H12 (PB_1.25mm) onto the main I2C bus: H12 pin 2 carries NET0081 (I2C_SDA) and pin 3 carries NET0030 (I2C_SCL), with VCC on +5V and GND on GND. No HC-SR04-style ultrasonic sensor with trigger/echo on two GPIOs is drawn anywhere on the sheet.
anomalies.expected: The specification states the TF-Luna LiDAR is unwired and excluded from the board — 'all four pins (VCC, SDA, SCL, GND) typed free — i.e., it is not connected to any net in this design' — and that 'the water-level sensing that is actually wired and actually used by firmware is an HC-SR04-style ultrasonic sensor read on two ESP32 GPIOs'.

evidence.quote: Sheet 1, 'Water Height Sensor': PR6 LIDAR (VCC/SDA/SCL/GND/TX) -> H12 PB_1.25mm; H12 pin2 = NET0081, pin3 = NET0030 (the I2C_SDA/I2C_SCL nets)

the r2 netlist shows PR1 with on_board: no ... all four pins (VCC, SDA, SCL, GND) typed free — i.e., it is not connected to any net in this design ... The water-level sensing that is actually wired and actually used by firmware is an HC-SR04-style ultrasonic sensor read on two ESP32 GPIOs

anomalies.impact: The intended ultrasonic water-level sensor is absent and an unintended LiDAR interface is placed on the shared I2C bus. Firmware that expects the ultrasonic trigger/echo GPIOs will find no sensor, so ATO water-level distance sensing does not behave as intended; the LiDAR also adds an extra I2C load/device that the firmware does not address.

anomalies.observed: On sheet 1 'POWER TRAIN', the AZ1117-3.3 LDO U1 has its VO tied to the global +3V3 net, and the ESP32-C6-DevKit block M5B also has its 3V3 pin tied to the same +3V3 net (while its 5V0 pin is fed from +5V). This joins the board LDO output with the DevKit's internal regulator output.
anomalies.expected: Per the spec, +3V3 is generated by the AZ1117 (U2 in the reference) and powers only the I2C pull-ups, isolator primary sides and TMC2209 VCC_IO; the DevKit is powered from +5V at its 5V0 pin and its 3V3 is internal. The two 3V3 sources should not be merged onto one net.

evidence.quote: Sheet 1: U1 AZ1117-3.3 VI=+5V, VO=+3V3; M5B ESP32-C6-DEVKIT 5V0=+5V, 3V3=+3V3 (same global label)
U2 ... VO feeds +3V3, which powers the I2C pull-ups ... isolator primary sides, and TMC2209 logic (VCC_IO) ... U1 ... +5V rail ... Powers ESP32-C6 DevKit (5V0 pin)

anomalies.impact: Two 3.3 V regulator outputs (the board AZ1117 and the DevKit's onboard LDO) are paralleled on one rail, which can cause regulator contention/back-feeding and unstable 3V3, deviating from the intended single-source peripheral rail.

parsed.summary: The drawing deviates from the intended design in two ways: the TF-Luna LiDAR (PR6), which the spec says is unwired and excluded, is instead connected to the I2C bus via H12 while the intended ultrasonic water-level sensor is missing; and the ESP32 DevKit's internal 3V3 output is tied to the board +3V3 rail, paralleling the AZ1117.
